posts.body: will stop producing milk? I stopped breast feeding a week ago and they are still leaking. 😢

could take ages! i think mine tok quite a few months with DS1 and i remember them being like they had bricks in em and felt quite bruised when i lay on them! the problem is, just touching them or a hot shower will encourage your flow again and so its this that takes the time... i remember having no leaks for a few days and so went out with breastpads... and typically one boobed soaked me!! how embaressing lol!!

Yeah could take upto a month, because a production has to stop and a lot of times certain things trigger your milk to leak, therefore prolonging ur milk production.
lol, so true houseofblue, know what ya mean about that 😊

Got bad news for ya babe, it could take longer than a month.... I actually was producing a very small amount of breast milk in my right breast even after Aaralyn was 4 1/2 yrs old (stopped bf when she was 8 months!!)
The Dr's even did tests to make sure it was breast milk and not some other kind of bad fluid.  I finally have stopped producing milk now!  Good luck hun I hope your's dry up very soon!

Wow, that what a long time to produce milk for Tammy.  I didn't even know you could produce milk for that long if you weren't using it?
I was producing milk for about 2mths after i stopped BF jake, and i didn't manage to feed him for that long, as he wanted to feed constantly. With lolly to look after too, i found that really hard.  I mixed fed until he was around 3mths. Then he was put on formula.  So you sound perfectly normal to me to still be leaking after only a week hun.  I hope it doesn't take you too long to dry up  😘   Xx

i breast feed alisa for a short time and tried with twions didnt work they didnt want it and i am still leaking occasionaly now if i lean on them or kids bundle me or shower and have been since i had alisa 2 and 1/2yrs ago
Mine sometimes dribble a little just before I'm due on.

i think it can take about a few weeks, try cabbage leaves in the bra, it helps with the engorgement, they take the sting out of it.
My MW suggested it and it works beelive me!!!
